candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E get cough or e dey breathe hard. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E no get fever. Dem count im breath for 1 minute. Di pikin dey calm. E never get convulsion before. E no be lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything.
